description: Ministry of Defence - Award of the Weerodara Vibhushanaya to the Air Force Person
categorisation: This gazette exclusively announces a personnel change - the conferral of a gallantry award (Weerodara Vibhushanaya) to a named individual (Leading Aircraftsman Rathnayake DAWMNDB) by the President. It contains the name and basic title/rank of the recipient but does not describe any detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes. This fits the definition of Type 2 (People Gazette) as it focuses solely on a government personnel action without detailing administrative functions or responsibilities.
